records.source: Hey! You're going to win by a longshot today, I know it. Make us proud!
records.translation: Hoy! Alam kong mananalo ka nang may malaking lamang ngayon. Bigyan mo kami ng maipagmamalaki!

records.source: Hi, honey. Good luck today in the ice fishing contest.$0
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Sana palarin ka sa paligsahan sa pangingisda sa yelo ngayon.$0

records.source: I've been practicing my fishing technique. I won't hold back against you, my dear.$1
records.translation: Sinasanay ko ang pamamaraan ko sa pangingisda. Hindi kita pagbibigyan, mahal ko.$1

records.source: Have you ever thrown a bunch of pebbles on a frozen lake? It makes a very nice sound.#$e#...Don't tell my dad, but I'm wearing the Winter Star sweater under this coat.
records.translation: Nakapaghagis ka na ba ng maraming maliliit na bato sa isang nagyeyelong lawa? Napakaganda ng tunog niyon.#$e#...Huwag mong sabihin kay Tatay, pero suot ko ang suweter ng Bituin ng Taglamig sa ilalim ng amerikana ko.

records.source: Ice sculpting is a rewarding challenge for me. It's a distinct material that I'm not used to!
records.translation: Isang kasiya-siyang hamon sa akin ang paglililok ng yelo. Kakaiba itong materyal na hindi ko nakasanayan!

records.source: Water ice... a most profound substance, indeed. Necessary for life, it makes a fitting material for statuary meant to represent the living form.
records.translation: Yelong mula sa tubig... tunay ngang napakalalim na sangkap. Kailangan sa buhay, kaya angkop itong materyal para sa estatuwang kumakatawan sa anyong buhay.

records.source: The key to making a well-crafted snowman begins with ensuring a level foundation and avoiding excessive weight on the upper section.$3
records.translation: Nagsisimula ang paggawa ng mahusay na taong-niyebe sa pagtiyak na pantay ang pundasyon at pag-iwas sa labis na bigat sa itaas na bahagi.$3

records.source: Winter can be really hard on animals. Did you install heaters in your coops and barns?
records.translation: Talagang mahirap ang taglamig para sa mga hayop. Naglagay ka ba ng mga pampainit sa mga Kulungan at Kamalig mo?

records.source: You ever notice how quiet it is in the snow?
records.translation: Napansin mo na ba kung gaano katahimik kapag may niyebe?

records.source: Our family has matching Winter Star sweaters.#$e#Now, if only Abigail would wear hers...$2
records.translation: Magkakatugma ang mga suweter ng Bituin ng Taglamig ng pamilya namin.#$e#Kung isusuot lang sana ni Abigail ang kaniya...$2

records.source: Hi, @. Are you finding any time to relax from your farming duties this winter?$0
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Nakakahanap ka ba ng oras para magpahinga mula sa mga tungkulin mo sa bukid ngayong taglamig?$0

records.source: Ahh... The forest has entered her long slumber for the winter...$1
records.translation: Ahh... Nagsimula na ang mahabang pagtulog ng gubat ngayong taglamig...$1

records.source: You think anyone would mind if I took a dip in the frozen lake after the festival?#$e#I've heard ice baths are good for the muscles.
records.translation: May tututol kaya kung lumangoy ako sa nagyeyelong lawa pagkatapos ng pista?#$e#Narinig kong mabuti sa mga kalamnan ang paliligo sa yelo.

records.source: When you get old and bald like me, you need a good, warm hat.
records.translation: Kapag matanda at kalbo ka nang tulad ko, kailangan mo ng magandang mainit na sombrero.

records.source: You never know... this could be the last time I ever make a snowman with Alex.#$e#Life is short, dear. Make sure to treasure every moment.
records.translation: Hindi mo masasabi... baka ito na ang huling pagkakataong gagawa ako ng taong-niyebe kasama si Alex.#$e#Maikli ang buhay, mahal. Tiyaking pahalagahan ang bawat sandali.

records.source: Hello, @. It's that time of the year again for the ice fishing festival.#$b#Speak with me when you're ready to start the competition!$1
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Panahon na muli para sa Pista ng Yelo.#$b#Kausapin mo ako kapag handa ka nang simulan ang paligsahan!$1

records.source: These lumps of snow won't form into balls...$0#$e#I think I'm better working in the heat than in the cold.$2
records.translation: Ayaw mabilog ng mga bunton ng niyebeng ito...$0#$e#Sa tingin ko, mas mahusay akong magtrabaho sa init kaysa sa lamig.$2

records.source: A snowman has to look the part! Isn't the top hat and scarf stylish?
records.translation: Kailangang magmukhang tunay na taong-niyebe ang isang taong-niyebe! Hindi ba makisig ang sombrerong silindro at bandana?

records.source: I'm too nervous to walk on the frozen lake...#$e#I read a book once, where a girl fell through the ice.#$b#She was okay! But... I've been cautious about it ever since.
records.translation: Masyado akong kinakabahang maglakad sa nagyeyelong lawa...#$e#Minsan akong nagbasa ng aklat kung saan lumusot sa yelo ang isang babae.#$b#Ayos lang siya! Pero... naging maingat na ako mula noon.

records.source: $y 'I lost last year because I chose a bad spot. I have a good feeling things will be different this time around._I don't think the location matters._Hah. Says you! I'll prove you wrong._I'll beat you anyway._...$4_Well, good luck._Same to you, kid.'
records.translation: $y 'Natalo ako noong nakaraang taon dahil pumili ako ng masamang puwesto. Malakas ang pakiramdam kong mag-iiba ang mga bagay ngayon._Sa tingin ko, hindi mahalaga ang puwesto._Hah. Sabi mo lang iyan! Patutunayan kong mali ka._Tatalunin pa rin kita._...$4_Sana palarin ka._Ikaw rin, bata.'

records.source: I'm glad I wore earmuffs, it's freezing out here!$0#$e#I brought my camera this year. It's perfect lighting for a winter photoshoot!
records.translation: Mabuti na lang at nagsuot ako ng pantakip sa tainga, napakaginaw dito!$0#$e#Dinala ko ang kamera ko ngayong taon. Perpekto ang liwanag para sa pagkuha ng mga larawan sa taglamig!

records.source: Gatherings like this are a good way to build community with our neighbors.#$e#It's nice how cold weather seems to bring people together.
records.translation: Magandang paraan ang mga pagtitipong tulad nito para patatagin ang ugnayan natin sa mga kapitbahay.#$e#Maganda kung paanong tila pinaglalapit ng malamig na panahon ang mga tao.

records.source: You ready for the contest? We all think you're going to win.
records.translation: Handa ka na ba sa paligsahan? Naniniwala kaming lahat na mananalo ka.
